assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of symptomatic atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome.

Given the history of unexplained cardiac arrhythmias and the need to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances, mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture continuous electrocardiographic data during daily activities.
mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is medically necessary
This service supports the documented diagnoses of I48.91 and I49.5
the indication note confirms the need to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances
